newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico records $109 mln trade surplus in April.
newsitem.headline: Mexico records $109 mln trade surplus in April.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Ministry said Monday the country recorded a trade surplus of $109 million in April.
Exports in April totaled $9.121 billion and imports totaled $9.012 billion, the ministry said.
Manufactured exports totaled $7.748 billion in April, petroleum product exports were $943 million, farm exports were $383 million and mining exports were $47 million.
Imports of intermediate goods totaled $6.96 billion in April, capital goods $1.263 billion and consumer goods imports were $789 million.
